messages:
Devon: Heads up  we're debating whether SLOs routed to the 'quiet lane' should be visible as active rules in Console. Hiding them leads to confusion.
Kali: Show with a distinct state: 'quieted' + small explainer. Users need to see that the rule exists.
Murray: Telemetry needs raw_hits, quieted_hits, and an estimated would_have_escalated counter. Also include sampling_rate in exports.
Devon: API sketch: notify_policy.quiet_mode: enum('off','quiet','soft_snooze'), quiet_window_s, bypass_labels array. Backwards compatible.
Kali: UX: SLO card header shows a tiny 'Quieted' pill with a hover describing routing and a link to 'preview simulated pages'.
ops-bot: notifier-service v2.15 deploy started -> staging
Murray: Important: quieted events must still be billed to quotas. Emit both counters so tenants can't bypass limits.
Devon: I'll write an RFC with schema, telemetry names, sample dashboards, and a rollout plan (internal FF -> beta tenants -> GA). Will include mock preview UI.
ops-bot: notifier-service v2.15 deploy succeeded -> staging (11:00)
